source.numbering: Al-Fatihah includes Basmala as 1:1. Other opening Basmalas are shown separately from the numbered ayah.
source.orthography: Tanzil Simple (Imlaei), not an Uthmani facsimile.

review.scope: New typeset writing curriculum. No authored stroke-order assessment.

ayahs.focus: Write from right to left. Keep joined letters connected, then check the dots and vowel marks.
